blocks.text: High Capacitance in Small Package: Offers a high 4.7µF capacitance value in a compact 0603 footprint, ideal for space-constrained designs.
Stable Over Temperature: X7R dielectric provides a stable capacitance value across a wide temperature range, with capacitance change within ±15% from -55°C to +125°C .
Suitable for Decoupling & Filtering: Well-suited for bypass, decoupling, and filtering applications in power supplies and digital circuits .
Non-Polarized: No orientation restrictions during PCB assembly.
RoHS Compliant: Meets current environmental standards.

DC Bias Derating (Critical): X7R is a Class 2 dielectric. Capacitance decreases significantly when DC voltage is applied. A 10V rated capacitor may lose a substantial portion of its 4.7µF value at operating voltages near its rating . For critical applications, always check the manufacturer’s DC bias derating curve for this specific part. You may need to select a higher voltage rating (e.g., 16V or 25V) or a higher nominal capacitance value to ensure the required effective capacitance at your working voltage .

Capacitance Aging: X7R capacitors exhibit a gradual loss of capacitance over time, which is another characteristic of Class 2 dielectrics . This aging effect should be considered for long-life or precision applications.
Typical Applications: Commonly used as bulk decoupling capacitors on power rails, filters for DC-DC converters, and general-purpose bypass capacitors

blocks.text: High-Efficiency 3A DC-DC Step-Down Regulator (40V Input) – EUP3453WIR1

The EUP3453WIR1 is a robust, current-mode step-down (buck) switching regulator IC, designed to efficiently convert higher input voltages into a lower, stable output voltage. Capable of delivering up to 3A of continuous current, it’s an excellent choice for demanding applications requiring reliable power conversion with excellent line and load regulation.

Operating over a wide input voltage range from 4.75V up to 40V, the EUP3453WIR1 offers significant flexibility for various power sources, including automotive batteries and industrial supplies. Its adjustable output voltage (set via external resistors) from 0.92V to 15V allows precise power delivery tailored to your specific load requirements.
Wide Input Voltage Range (4.75V – 40V): Benefit: Provides versatility for use in diverse applications, including automotive (12V/24V systems) and industrial power supplies.
High Output Current (Up to 3A): Benefit: Capable of powering demanding loads like high-power LEDs, charging circuits, and embedded systems.
Adjustable Output Voltage (0.92V – 15V): Benefit: Allows customization of the output voltage using simple external resistors to meet specific application needs.
Programmable Current Limit (CC Mode): Benefit: Protects both the power supply and the load by entering a constant current mode when the programmed threshold is reached, ideal for battery charging.
Programmable Over Voltage Protection (OVP): Benefit: Adds an extra layer of safety by shutting down switching if the output voltage exceeds a user-defined threshold.
High Efficiency (Up to 95%): Benefit: Minimizes power loss and heat generation, crucial for compact designs and battery-powered devices.

Integrated Protection Features: Includes secondary cycle-by-cycle current limiting, thermal shutdown, and input undervoltage lockout (UVLO). Benefit: Enhances overall system reliability and protects the IC from fault conditions.
Internal Soft-Start: Benefit: Minimizes inrush current during startup, reducing stress on input components and preventing output voltage overshoot.

Development board for theCH552G low-cost 8-bit 8051 core microcontrollers with native USB 2.0 and Arduino IDE support.

The CH55x is an 8-bit enhanced E8051 core MCU compatible with the MCS51 instruction set. 79% of its instructions are single-byte single-cycle instructions, and the average instruction speed is 8 – 15 times faster than that of the standard MCS51. The special xRAM supports direct memory access (DMA), data fast copy command, and double DPTR pointers. The CH55x has a built-in USB controller and USB transceiver, USB 2.0 full-speed (12Mbps) and low-speed (1.5Mbps) traffic, data packets of up to 64 bytes, and DMA. It has a factory built-in bootloader so firmware can be uploaded directly via USB without the need for an additional programming device.
-Built-in Flash/RAM Built-in 16KB program memory ROM, 256 bytes internal iRAM and 1KB on-chip xRAM, which supports DMA direct memory access
-USB : Embedded USB controller and USB transceiver, supporting USB2.0 full speed and low speed host or device mode. Support up to 64-byte data packet, built-in FIFO, support DMA
-UART: 2 full-duplex asynchronous serial ports, both of them support high baud rate communication. UART0 is a standard MCS51 serial port
-Timer: 3 groups of timers/counters, supporting 2 signal capture and 2 PWM output
-SPI: 1 SPI communication interface, built-in FIFO, support master-slave mode
-ADC: 4-channel 8-bit A/D analog-to-digital converter, supporting voltage comparison
-Touch: 6-channel capacitance detection, supporting up to 15 touch buttons and independent timed interrupt
Go to “Tools” -> “Board” -> “CH55x Boards” and select your chip.
Go to “Tools” and set the desired board options.
Go to “File” -> “Examples” -> “Examples for CH55x Board” and select a Sketch of your choice.

If your board is never used with ch55xduino before, you need to make the ch55x chip enter the bootloader mode. Hold the BOOT button pressed while connecting the board to the USB port of your PC. You do not need to do this if you have installed a blank new chip on the board.
Now you can upload your sketch.

you can also use the Zadig Tool to install the correct driver. Here, click “Options” -> “List All Devices” and select the USB module. Then install the libusb-win32 driver. To do this, the board must be connected and the CH55x must be in bootloader mode.

A brand new chip starts automatically in bootloader mode as soon as it is connected to the PC via USB. Once firmware has been uploaded, the bootloader must be started manually for new uploads. To do this, the board must first be disconnected from the USB port and all voltage sources. Now press the BOOT button and keep it pressed while reconnecting the board to the USB port of your PC. The chip now starts again in bootloader mode, the BOOT button can be released and new firmware can be uploaded within the next couple of seconds.

The TJA1057 is part of the Mantis family of high-speed CAN transceivers. It provides an interface between a Controller Area Network (CAN) protocol controller and the physical two-wire CAN bus. The transceiver is designed for high-speed CAN applications in the automotive industry, providing the differential transmit and receive capability to (a microcontroller with) a CAN protocol controller. The TJA1057 offers a feature set optimized for 12 V automotive applications, with significant improvements over first- and second-generation CAN transceivers from NXP, such as the TJA1050, and excellent ElectroMagnetic Compatibility (EMC) performance. The TJA1057 also displays ideal passive behavior to the CAN bus when the supply voltage is off. Variants with a VIO pin can be interfaced directly with microcontrollers with supply voltages from 3.3 V to 5 V. The TJA1057 implements the CAN physical layer as defined in ISO 11898-2:2016 and SAE J2284-1 to SAE J2284-5. The TJA1057T is specified for data rates up to 1 Mbit/s. Additional timing parameters defining loop delay symmetry are specified for the other variants. This implementation enables reliable communication in the CAN FD fast phase at data rates up to 5 Mbit/s. The TJA1057B and TJA1057C feature shorter propagation delay, supporting larger network topologies. These features make the TJA1057 an excellent choice for HS-CAN networks that only require basic CAN functionality.

MAX1487ESA Low Power Half-Duplex RS485 RS422 Transceiver

The MAX1487 are low-power transceivers for RS-485 and RS422 communication. Each part contains one driver and one receiver. The driver slew rates of the MAX481, MAX485, MAX490, MAX491, and MAX1487 are not limited, allowing them to transmit up to 2.5Mbps. These transceivers draw between 120µA and 500µA of supply current when unloaded or fully loaded with disabled drivers. it operate from a single 5V supply. Drivers are short-circuit current limited and are protected against excessive power dissipation by thermal shutdown circuitry that places the driver outputs into a high-impedance state. The receiver input has a fail-safe feature that guarantees a logic-high output if the input is open circuit. The MAX1487 feature quarter-unit-load receiver input impedance, allowing up to 128 MAX1487 transceivers on the bus. MAX1487 are designed for half-duplex applications.

The unit is manually operated by pressing and holding the power button, making it simple and direct to use during testing.

The UT12A is built for residential, commercial, and industrial electrical environments. What's the benefit of 16MB flash over the standard 4MB ESP32 boards?

More on-board storage for OTA firmware updates (keeping a backup image while updating), plus room for a SPIFFS/LittleFS file system to store web assets, logs, or configuration data alongside the application code.
Does more flash memory make the board faster?
No — flash size affects storage capacity, not processing speed. This board uses the same dual-core Xtensa LX6 CPU at up to 240MHz as standard ESP32-WROOM-32 boards.
Can I program this board with Arduino IDE?
Yes — it supports Arduino IDE, ESP-IDF, MicroPython, and PlatformIO, the same development workflows as other ESP32 boards.
Is the USB-to-serial chip built in, or do I need a separate programmer?
It's built in — the board includes an integrated CP2102-equivalent USB-to-serial interface, so a single USB cable handles both power and programming.

The Raspberry Pi 4B 2GB is the entry-level memory option in the Raspberry Pi 4 lineup, built around the same Broadcom BCM2711 quad-core Cortex-A72 CPU as the 4GB and 8GB variants. It's one of RAM Electronics' Raspberry Pi boards, suited to lighter desktop use, learning projects, and budget-conscious builds where more RAM isn't needed.
Broadcom BCM2711, Quad-core Cortex-A72 (ARM v8) 64-bit SoC @ 1.5GHz

The most affordable way into the Raspberry Pi 4 platform — same CPU, same I/O, same GPIO layout as the higher-RAM models.
Enough memory for single-application use: a lightweight desktop, a media player, a basic web server, or a single-purpose IoT project.
Fully backward-compatible 40-pin GPIO header, so existing HATs and add-on boards from older Raspberry Pi models still work.

Need more headroom for multitasking or heavier software? The Raspberry Pi 4B 4GB and Raspberry Pi 4B 8GB use the identical board with more RAM. For the newer generation entirely, the Raspberry Pi 5 4GB steps up to a newer CPU and faster I/O.
Need something even more basic or lower-cost? The Raspberry Pi 3B covers lighter projects at a lower price point.
Common Uses for the Raspberry Pi 4B 2GB
Retro gaming emulation and single-purpose media players.
Basic home automation and IoT hub projects.
Learning Linux, programming, and general computing fundamentals.
Lightweight network appliances — ad-blocking setups, simple file sharing, or a print server.
Classroom and workshop use, where multiple low-cost boards matter more than per-unit performance.
Is 2GB of RAM enough for a Raspberry Pi 4?

For a single-purpose project — a media player, a basic web server, a retro-gaming console, or a learning board — 2GB is enough. If you plan to run a full desktop environment with several applications open at once, the 4GB or 8GB variant handles that more comfortably.
What's the difference between the Raspberry Pi 4B 2GB and the 4GB/8GB models?

All three use the identical Broadcom BCM2711 Cortex-A72 CPU, the same ports, and the same GPIO layout — the only difference is the amount of LPDDR4 RAM, which affects multitasking headroom rather than raw processing speed.
Can I upgrade the 2GB board to more RAM later?

Not on the same physical board — RAM is soldered onto the Raspberry Pi 4, so the amount is fixed at purchase. If a project later needs more memory, the 4GB or 8GB variant would need to be purchased separately.
Does the 2GB model support the same accessories as the other Raspberry Pi 4 boards?
Yes — the GPIO header, USB ports, micro-HDMI outputs, and camera/display connectors are identical across all Raspberry Pi 4 memory variants, so HATs, cases, and cables are fully interchangeable.

Need an affordable way into the Raspberry Pi 4 platform for a single-purpose project? Shop the Raspberry Pi 4B 2GB at RAM Electronics, and step up to the 4GB or 8GB variant if your project ever needs more multitasking headroom.

The color sensor board has TCS230 color sensor. The TCS230 programmable color light-to-frequency converter combines configurable silicon photodiodes and a current-to-frequency converter on a single chip. The light-to-frequency converter consists of an 8x8 array of photodiodes with red, blue, and green colored filters (16 photodiodes each) and 16 photodiodes with no filter.

The photodiode filters can be selected using S2 and S3 pins. The current-to-frequency converter generates frequency proportional to current generated by the photodiodes. The photodiode array and current-to-frequency converter together generate a square wave output (50% duty cycles) with frequency directly proportional to light intensity (irradiance). Output frequency scaling is also pin-selectable (using S0 and S1 pins).

Both frequency scaling and filter selection pins are pulled high on the module. Four white LEDs are provided for better color recognition in low-light conditions. The sensor generates frequency proportional to the intensity of light captured by the selected filtered photodiodes. On full scale sensor generates 600 KHz pulses when saturated. Since the sensor has four types of filters, red, green, blue, and clear (no filter), we get RGBY information of the color exposed to the sensor and hence can identify the color. The sensor can be used for object tracking.

The PD4164-3 is a 65,536-word by 1-bit dynamic N-channel MOS DRAM designed for single +5V operation. It employs a double-poly silicon-gate process and a single-transistor storage cell, maximizing storage density while minimizing power through integrated 512 sense amplifiers and advanced dynamic circuitry. The device internally generates negative substrate bias, making biasing automatic and transparent to the user.

Its architecture uses multiplexed address inputs enabling a compact 16-pin DIP package that yields high system bit density and automated handling compatibility. The three-state, non-latched TTL-compatible output is CAS-controlled independently of RAS; holding CAS low preserves output data while RAS performs refresh cycles. A hidden-refresh capability allows CAS to remain low during RAS-only refresh operations.

Refresh management covers 128 refresh cycles using A0–A6 within each 2 ms period, and supports normal read/write, read-modify-write, RAS-only refresh and page-mode operation. Designed with low power in mind, it balances refresh timing and circuitry to maximize yield and compatibility across DRAM generations, making it suitable for legacy systems requiring compact, single-bit memory elements. Its design prioritizes manufacturing yield and long-term reliability through conservative refresh characteristics and minimized power dissipation, simplifying integration into memory subsystems and easing maintenance in fielded equipment.

The ATmega8535-16JI is an 8-bit AVR® microcontroller that combines a compact Harvard-style RISC core with on-chip nonvolatile memory and a rich peripheral set. Optimized for low power and efficient code density, it executes most instructions in a single clock cycle and achieves up to ~16 MIPS at a 16 MHz clock. The device integrates 8 KB of in-system programmable Flash, 512 bytes of EEPROM and 512 bytes of SRAM, making it suitable for embedded code and small data storage without external memory.

Hardware peripherals are comprehensive: multiple timers (two 8-bit, one 16-bit), four PWM channels, an 8-channel 10-bit ADC (with additional differential/gain options in some packages), USART, SPI and TWI (I²C) interfaces, watchdog timer, and analog comparator. The chip provides 32 programmable I/O lines and flexible sleep modes for power management (Idle, ADC Noise Reduction, Power-save, Power-down, Standby, Extended Standby). These on-chip resources let designers build responsive, low-power control systems with minimal external components.

Physically available in several packages (including 44-lead PLCC as the -16JI part), the ATmega8535 supports In-System Programming via SPI and an optional boot section for field updates. Built with Atmel’s high-density nonvolatile memory process and backed by a broad toolchain (compilers, debuggers, evaluation kits), it’s a straightforward drop-in for projects needing a capable 8-bit MCU with reliable I/O and analog capabilities.

It operates over a wide input voltage range of 8V to 37V and can deliver up to 1.0A of continuous current per bridge, making it suitable for a variety of motor-driven applications.

The device includes a dual H-bridge power MOSFET driver with a simple STEP/DIR interface, making it easy to control the stepper motor. Additionally, the DRV8884 offers a selection of decay modes slow, mixed, and fixed off-time PWM chopping ensuring efficient and smooth motor operation with minimal torque ripple. This makes it especially useful in systems where smooth motion and reduced noise are crucial, such as printers, 3D printers, and robotic applications. The current is regulated without the need for external sense resistors, contributing to overall energy savings.

In addition to its precision control, the DRV8884 includes several built-in protection features like overcurrent protection, thermal shutdown, and undervoltage lockout to ensure reliable operation and prevent damage to the motor and IC. The low-power sleep mode (<20 μA) provides energy efficiency during standby. These integrated protections, combined with its robust current control features, make the DRV8884 an ideal choice for designs requiring both high performance and system safety.

The KYORITSU KEW 2062 Clamp Power Meter (Made In THAILAND) is a portable clamp-on AC power meter engineered for comprehensive power quality assessments. blocks.text: Smoke and Flammable MQ-2 Gas Sensor

The MQ-2 Gas Sensor is a highly sensitive semiconductor sensor engineered to detect a wide array of flammable gases and smoke, making it an essential component for safety and monitoring applications. Its sensing element, composed of tin dioxide (SnO2), exhibits low conductivity in clean air but increases conductivity significantly when exposed to target gases such as liquefied petroleum gas (LPG), methane, propane, hydrogen, alcohol, and smoke. This characteristic enables precise detection across a concentration range of 300 to 10,000 parts per million (ppm), ensuring reliable performance in diverse environments.

makers-286224.summary: STC-1000 HW-524C controls heating and cooling with dual relays, offering precise temperature regulation for DIY, aquarium, and home automation projects.

blocks.text: The STC-1000 HW-524C Digital Temperature Controller is a versatile and reliable device designed for temperature regulation in various applications. Operating within the voltage range of 110-220VAC, this digital temperature controller is commonly used in home brewing, aquariums, and industrial applications, where precise temperature control is essential. It provides users with an easy-to-use interface to maintain specific temperature ranges for equipment, systems, and processes.

The STC-1000 features a digital display, which provides real-time temperature readings, and allows users to easily adjust the desired temperature setpoint. The controller also includes a sensor input, usually in the form of a thermocouple or NTC thermistor, to measure the current temperature accurately. Once the system’s temperature reaches the setpoint, the controller can trigger an action such as turning on or off heating or cooling devices, depending on the configuration.

One of the key features of the STC-1000 HW-524C is its dual relay outputs, which can control both heating and cooling elements independently. This allows the controller to maintain a precise temperature range by activating the appropriate devices based on whether the temperature is too high or too low. The temperature differential (hysteresis) can be adjusted to fine-tune the controller’s response, ensuring stable and consistent operation.

The device is designed to be user-friendly, with simple controls for temperature adjustments, settings, and calibration. It also includes various protection features, including over-temperature protection and overload protection, ensuring the safety and longevity of both the controller and the connected equipment.

In summary, the STC-1000 HW-524C Digital Temperature Controller offers an efficient, reliable, and easy-to-use solution for temperature regulation in a wide range of applications. With its dual relay outputs, adjustable settings, and robust features, it ensures precise and stable temperature control in diverse environments.
Dual Control for Heating and Cooling: The STC-1000 offers independent control of heating and cooling devices, making it versatile for different applications that require both temperature regulation.

Precise Temperature Control: With a digital interface and easy-to-adjust settings, it ensures highly accurate temperature control, making it ideal for sensitive applications like brewing or aquarium care.
User-Friendly Interface: The unit is designed with an intuitive and easy-to-use interface, allowing users to set and adjust temperatures without technical expertise.

Flexible Applications: This controller is not limited to one specific use. It’s suitable for a variety of applications including home brewing, HVAC systems, aquarium temperature control, and industrial processes.
Low Energy Consumption: The STC-1000 is energy-efficient, helping to reduce electricity usage by only activating heating or cooling elements when necessary.

Temperature Differentiation: The controller allows for adjusting the temperature differential or hysteresis, which helps avoid constant cycling of the heating and cooling elements, thus enhancing device longevity.
Safety Features: Designed with overload protection and over-temperature safety features, ensuring that both the device and the system it controls are protected from damage.
Compact and Durable Design: Its small size and high-quality components make it durable and easy to integrate into various systems, even in tight spaces.
Broad Voltage Range: With compatibility for 110-220VAC power input, the STC-1000 is highly adaptable for different electrical setups.
Reliable Performance: The controller is engineered for long-term, stable performance, making it a dependable choice for both residential and commercial applications.

Built to handle currents up to 10 amps, this relay is widely used in applications ranging from industrial automation and HVAC systems to home appliances and DIY electronics. Its SPDT (Single Pole Double Throw) configuration allows for switching between two circuits, enabling flexible control over connected devices or loads.

Housed in a durable enclosure and designed for through-hole mounting, the relay easily integrates into printed circuit boards (PCBs), making it an ideal choice for both prototyping and mass production. The 5-pin design simplifies the installation process and ensures solid connectivity, while the internal construction offers dependable operation even under continuous use. The 24VDC coil energizes the relay smoothly, triggering the internal switch to change its contact position—either completing or interrupting the circuit depending on the system’s logic.

This also plays a crucial role in protecting sensitive electronic components. By providing galvanic isolation between the control side and the load side, it shields control circuitry from voltage spikes, electrical noise, or surges that might otherwise cause damage. Its robust performance, compact size, and straightforward functionality make it a staple in countless electrical and electronic systems.

Whether it’s used to control lighting, activate motors, or manage power distribution in automated systems, this relay offers a practical and economical solution. With a design focused on durability and consistent switching action, it supports long service life and stable performance across a wide variety of environments. Its versatility, combined with ease of use, makes it a trusted component in both commercial and personal projects.

blocks.text: The 7412 Triple 3-Input NAND Gate is a digital logic integrated circuit containing three independent NAND gates, each with three input terminals. Each gate produces a LOW output when all three inputs are HIGH. Otherwise, its output remains in the non-conducting state, allowing the output to be pulled HIGH using an appropriate external pull-up resistor.

The IC features open-collector outputs, making it useful for wired logic connections and interfacing with compatible digital circuits. Its DIP-14 through-hole package is suitable for PCB assembly, breadboard prototyping, and educational electronics applications. Because the outputs are open-collector, a suitable external pull-up resistor is required when a defined HIGH logic level is needed.

طقم مفكات صيانة دقيقة مغناطيسي متعدد الاستخدام ٢٦ قطعة هو طقم عملي مخصص لأعمال فك وتركيب الأجهزة الصغيرة والإلكترونيات الدقيقة. يناسب صيانة الهواتف، التابلت، اللابتوب، الكاميرات، الريموتات، الساعات، الألعاب، والأجهزة الإلكترونية التي تحتوي على مسامير صغيرة وتحتاج إلى أدوات دقيقة ومنظمة.

هذا الطقم مصمم ليكون حلًا بسيطًا ومتكاملًا لأعمال الصيانة اليومية. يأتي داخل علبة تخزين برتقالية عملية بغطاء شفاف، وبداخلها يد مفك معدنية، مجموعة رؤوس مفكات دقيقة، أداة شفط لرفع الشاشات أو الأسطح الناعمة، أدوات فتح بلاستيكية، ملقاط منحني، وصلة تمديد، وريشة فتح مثلثة. وجود كل هذه الأدوات داخل علبة واحدة يجعل الطقم مناسبًا للفنيين والهواة والطلاب وأي شخص يحتاج إلى طقم صغير لفك الأجهزة بدقة.

يد المفك مصنوعة من سبيكة ألومنيوم طبقًا للبيانات الظاهرة في الصور، وتحتوي على منطقة ممسكة محززة تساعد على التحكم أثناء فك المسامير الصغيرة. كما أن طرف اليد الخلفي قابل للدوران لتسهيل الضغط بإصبع واحد أثناء تدوير المفك، وهي ميزة مهمة عند التعامل مع مسامير دقيقة داخل الهواتف أو الأجهزة الصغيرة.

Herigo DBK HR-002 Power Bank is a high-capacity portable charging solution designed for users who need long-lasting backup power, faster charging performance, built-in cable convenience, and a clear digital display in one practical device. With a large 20000mAh battery capacity, 22.5W super fast charging support, built-in Type-C and Lightning cables, Type-C input and output, USB output, and a digital LED battery display, this power bank is suitable for daily use, travel, work, study, emergency charging, and long trips.

The Herigo DBK HR-002 is designed for users who need more capacity than a standard 10000mAh power bank while still keeping a portable and organized charging setup. It includes integrated Type-C and Lightning cable outputs, helping reduce the need to carry extra cables for compatible Android and Apple devices. The black design shown on the retail package and product visuals gives the unit a clean modern look, while the digital LED display helps monitor the remaining battery level more accurately than basic indicator lights.

According to the supplied images and package specifications, the HR-002 supports super fast charging up to 22.5W through supported output modes. The Type-C input supports up to 18W for recharging the power bank, while the USB output and built-in Type-C cable output can reach up to 22.5W for compatible devices. The Type-C output supports up to 20W, and the built-in Lightning cable supports up to 12W. Actual charging speed depends on device compatibility, charging protocol, cable condition, battery health, temperature, and whether multiple devices are connected at the same time.

The product is suitable for users who want one power bank for multiple charging scenarios, including smartphones, tablets, wireless earbuds, Bluetooth accessories, smart watches, and other compatible USB-powered devices. باور بانك هيريجو دي بي كيه اتش ار ٠٠٢ هو شاحن متنقل بسعة كبيرة ٢٠٠٠٠ ملي أمبير، مناسب لمن يحتاج طاقة احتياطية لفترة أطول مع دعم الشحن فائق السرعة والكابلات المدمجة. يتميز المنتج بتصميم أسود عملي، وشاشة رقمية واضحة، وكابل تايب سي مدمج وكابل لايتنينج مدمج، مما يجعله حل مناسب للاستخدام اليومي والسفر والطوارئ.

هذا الموديل مناسب للمستخدم الذي يريد باور بانك بسعة أكبر من الموديلات الصغيرة، مع الحفاظ على سهولة الحمل وتنظيم الكابلات. وجود كابل تايب سي مدمج وكابل لايتنينج مدمج يقلل الحاجة لحمل كابلات منفصلة، كما أن وجود مخرج عادي ومدخل ومخرج تايب سي يعطي مرونة جيدة مع أنواع مختلفة من الأجهزة المتوافقة.

طبقًا للصور والبيانات المرسلة، يدعم باور بانك هيريجو دي بي كيه اتش ار ٠٠٢ شحن فائق السرعة حتى ٢٢.٥ وات من خلال أوضاع خرج مدعومة. مدخل تايب سي يدعم حتى ١٨ وات لإعادة شحن الباور بانك، ومخرج تايب سي يدعم حتى ٢٠ وات، بينما المخرج العادي وكابل تايب سي المدمج يدعمان حتى ٢٢.٥ وات للأجهزة المتوافقة. كابل لايتنينج المدمج يدعم حتى ١٢ وات. سرعة الشحن الفعلية تعتمد على توافق الجهاز والكابل والبروتوكول وحالة البطارية ودرجة الحرارة وعدد الأجهزة المتصلة.

The battery pack comes with a JST 3-pin 2.54mm connector and three wires. Based on the battery label, the wire colors are Black for negative, Red for positive, and Yellow for temperature sensing. This makes it useful for devices or charging circuits that require battery voltage plus an additional temperature signal line. بطارية ليثيوم ١٨٦٥٠ مزدوجة توازي ٣٫٧ فولت ٢٤٠٠ مللي أمبير بفيشة ثلاثية هي بطارية قابلة للشحن مكونة من خليتين ١٨٦٥٠ موصلتين على التوازي. توصيل التوازي يحافظ على الجهد الاسمي عند ٣٫٧ فولت مع رفع السعة الإجمالية إلى ٢٤٠٠ مللي أمبير، مما يجعلها مناسبة للأجهزة المحمولة، والمشروعات الإلكترونية، والدوائر الذكية، والحساسات، والروبوتات الصغيرة، والأجهزة منخفضة الجهد.

تأتي البطارية بفيشة ثلاثية مقاس ٢٫٥٤ مللي متر مع ثلاثة أسلاك. حسب بيانات الملصق، السلك الأسود هو السالب، والسلك الأحمر هو الموجب، والسلك الأصفر مخصص لقياس الحرارة. لذلك تعتبر هذه البطارية مناسبة للأجهزة أو دوائر الشحن التي تحتاج إلى طرف موجب وطرف سالب بالإضافة إلى خط حساس حرارة. قبل التركيب، يجب التأكد من شكل الفيشة وترتيب الأطراف والقطبية والجهد المطلوب للجهاز.

blocks.text: 220V to 9V AC and 18V-0-18V AC 3A Dual Output Center-Tapped Step-Down Transformer

This 3A step-down power transformer converts a 220V AC mains input into two separate low-voltage AC outputs. The secondary side provides one 0-9V AC output through two wires and one center-tapped 18V-0-18V AC output through three wires, giving a total of five secondary output wires.

The separate secondary windings make this transformer suitable for projects that require a dedicated 9V AC supply together with a higher-voltage symmetrical 18V-0-18V AC supply. After adding suitable rectifier, filtering, and voltage-regulation circuits, the outputs can be used to build single-rail or positive and negative DC power supplies for amplifiers, control systems, and other electronic circuits.

blocks.text: FR4-CG Fiberglass Epoxy Insulation Sheet 500×300×0.8mm Yellow

The FR4-CG Fiberglass Epoxy Insulation Sheet 500×300×0.8mm Yellow is a high-quality technical sheet designed for electrical insulation, structural support, and general industrial or DIY electronic use. It is manufactured from glass fiber reinforced epoxy resin, giving it a strong balance of mechanical durability, dielectric insulation, and thermal stability. This makes it a practical choice for engineers, technicians, makers, and repair professionals who need a dependable non-conductive sheet for demanding applications.

This sheet is built with FR4-CG flame-retardant material, which is widely used in electrical and electronic environments where insulation reliability and physical strength are important. The fiberglass reinforcement improves stiffness and impact resistance, while the epoxy resin matrix helps maintain dimensional stability and long service life. With its 0.8mm thickness, the sheet is thin enough for compact assemblies while still providing useful rigidity and insulation performance.

One of the main advantages of this product is its strong electrical insulation capability. It offers high dielectric strength, high insulation resistance, and dependable separation between conductive parts. This makes it suitable for insulation barriers, electrical separators, spacers, protective layers, control panels, and custom fabricated insulating parts. It can also be used in prototyping environments where a durable insulating base is required instead of a copper clad PCB sheet.

The material also provides thermal resistance up to 155°C, making it suitable for electronics and electrical assemblies that may be exposed to elevated operating temperatures. Its UL94 V-0 flame-retardant rating adds extra confidence in applications where fire resistance is important. In addition, the sheet offers good moisture resistance and chemical resistance, helping it maintain performance over time in practical working conditions.

With its yellow color, this FR4-CG sheet is easy to identify during assembly, storage, and workshop use. The 500×300mm format provides a useful working area that can be cut, shaped, and adapted for different custom applications. Whether used in insulation work, electronic enclosures, machine separators, or DIY fabrication, this sheet provides a reliable and versatile solution for many technical tasks.

لوح عزل من الإيبوكسي المقوى بالألياف الزجاجية إف آر فور سي جي مقاس ٥٠٠×٣٠٠ مم بسمك ٠٫٨ مم أصفر هو لوح فني عالي الجودة مخصص للعزل الكهربائي والدعم الميكانيكي والاستخدامات الصناعية والفنية المختلفة. تم تصنيع هذا اللوح من راتنج إيبوكسي مقوى بالألياف الزجاجية، لذلك يجمع بين المتانة الميكانيكية الجيدة والعزل الكهربائي الممتاز والثبات الحراري المناسب للعديد من التطبيقات العملية.

يعتمد هذا المنتج على خامة إف آر فور سي جي المقاومة للاشتعال، وهي من الخامات المستخدمة بكثرة في البيئات الكهربائية والإلكترونية التي تحتاج إلى مستوى موثوق من العزل مع قدرة جيدة على التحمل. وجود الألياف الزجاجية داخل الخامة يساعد على زيادة الصلابة وتحسين مقاومة الصدمات، بينما يمنح الإيبوكسي اللوح ثباتًا جيدًا وعمر استخدام طويل. ومع سمك ٠٫٨ مم يوفر اللوح توازنًا ممتازًا بين النحافة العملية والصلابة المناسبة للتجهيز والتركيب.

من أهم مميزات هذا اللوح قدرته العالية على العزل الكهربائي، حيث يوفر فصلًا جيدًا بين الأجزاء الموصلة ويصلح للاستخدام كحاجز عزل أو فاصل أو قاعدة غير موصلة أو طبقة حماية داخل التجميعات الكهربائية والإلكترونية. كما يمكن استخدامه في تصنيع أجزاء عازلة مخصصة حسب الحاجة، أو في أعمال التطوير والتجهيز التي تحتاج إلى خامة عازلة قوية بدلًا من ألواح الدوائر المطبوعة النحاسية.

كما يتميز هذا اللوح بقدرة جيدة على تحمل الحرارة حتى ١٥٥ درجة مئوية، مما يجعله مناسبًا للاستخدام في التطبيقات التي قد تتعرض لحرارة تشغيل مرتفعة نسبيًا. كذلك فإن تصنيف مقاوم للاشتعال يمنحه ميزة إضافية في التطبيقات التي تتطلب مستوى أمان أعلى. بالإضافة إلى ذلك، يتمتع اللوح بمقاومة جيدة للرطوبة والمواد الكيميائية، مما يساعد على الحفاظ على خواصه الفنية لفترة طويلة في ظروف التشغيل المختلفة.

اللون الأصفر يسهل تمييز اللوح أثناء الاستخدام أو التخزين أو التجميع داخل الورش والمشروعات الفنية. كما أن المقاس ٥٠٠×٣٠٠ مم يوفر مساحة مناسبة يمكن قصها أو تشكيلها أو تجهيزها حسب التطبيق المطلوب. لذلك فهو اختيار عملي للمهندسين والفنيين والهواة في أعمال العزل والتجهيز والتطوير والتصنيع اليدوي.

تم تصنيع جسم الفيشة من النايلون العازل المعروف بمتانته الجيدة وقدرته على تحمل الاستخدام، مما يجعله مناسبًا للتطبيقات التي تحتاج إلى عزل جيد وثبات في التوصيل. التصميم ثنائي الطرف يجعل هذا المنتج مناسبًا جدًا للتوصيلات التي تعتمد على خطين، مثل خطوط التغذية أو الإشارات أو بعض التوصيلات الكهربائية البسيطة في المركبات والمعدات.

هذا الطقم مصمم للعمل مع أطراف مقاس 2.8 مم، كما أنه مناسب للأسلاك ذات القطر حتى 2.0 مم، مما يجعله خيارًا مرنًا في كثير من الاستخدامات العملية. كما أن تصميم الجزء الذكر والجزء الأنثى يساعد على تحقيق محاذاة سليمة أثناء التوصيل، مع تثبيت جيد عند التركيب لتقليل احتمالية ارتخاء الوصلة أثناء الاستخدام.

يمكن استخدام فيشة 2 طرف 2.8 مم في السيارات، الدراجات النارية، التروسيكلات، الكرفانات، السكوتر، الدراجات الرباعية، القوارب، والمركبات الأخرى، بالإضافة إلى العديد من مشاريع التوصيلات الكهربائية العامة. وهي مناسبة جدًا للفنيين والهواة ومهندسي الصيانة والكهربائيين الذين يحتاجون إلى جسم فيشة موثوق لتجهيز توصيلات مخصصة بطريقة مرتبة وقابلة للفصل عند الحاجة.
هذا المنتج يحتوي على جسم فيشة ذكر + جسم فيشة أنثى فقط، ولا يشمل الأطراف المعدنية الداخلية. لذلك يجب استخدام أطراف كبس متوافقة بشكل منفصل حسب التطبيق المطلوب.

blocks.text: LCD1602 Parallel LCD Display with IIC/I2C interface

If you want to add some visual output to your Arduino projects, you’ll need a display. If you need only little to display, the LCD1602 Parallel LCD Display with IIC/I2C interface is a quite good solution.

This is LCD1602 Parallel LCD Display that provides a simple and cost-effective solution for adding a 16×2 White on RGB Liquid Crystal Display into your project. The display is 16 character by 2 line display has a very clear and high contrast white text upon a blue background/backlight.

This is great blue backlight LCD display. It is fantastic for Arduino based project. This LCD1602 Parallel LCD Display with Yellow Backlight is very easy to interface with Arduino or Other Microcontrollers.

This display overcomes the drawback of LCD1602 Parallel LCD Display in which you’ll waste about 8 Pins on your Arduino for the display to get working. Luckily in this product, an I2C adapter is directly soldered right onto the pins of the display. So all you need to connect are the I2C pins, which shows a good library and little of coding.

The I2C is a type of serial bus developed by Philips, which uses two bidirectional lines, called SDA (Serial Data Line) and SCL (Serial Clock Line). Both must be connected via pulled-up resistors. The usage voltages are standard as 5V and 3.3V.

If you already have the I2C adapter soldered onto the board like in this product, the wiring is quite easy. You should usually have only four pins to hook up. VCC and GND of course. The LCD display works with 5 Volts. So we go for the 5V Pin.
The values shown on the display can be either a simple text or numerical values read by the sensors, such as temperature or pressure, or even the number of cycles that the Arduino is performing.

blocks.text: Wago LT-223-8 Panel Mount Wire Connector 8 In 8 Out – Spring Clamp Cable Terminal
Wago LT-223-8 Panel Mount Wire Connector 8 In 8 Out

The Wago LT-223-8 Panel Mount Wire Connector is a practical and efficient wiring solution designed for organized cable connection inside electrical panels, control cabinets, lighting systems, and compact installation spaces. With its 8 input and 8 output configuration, this connector allows multiple wires to be connected in a clean and structured way, making it ideal for parallel wiring, branching, and neat power distribution layouts.

This model uses a spring clamp connection mechanism, which makes installation much easier compared to traditional screw terminals. Wires can be inserted and secured quickly without twisting or soldering, helping reduce installation time and making maintenance or rewiring more convenient. The spring contact system also helps provide stable electrical performance and reliable wire holding during long-term use.

Its panel mount design makes it especially suitable for applications where the connector needs to remain fixed in place inside equipment, enclosures, or distribution systems. This gives the installation a more professional and organized appearance, while also helping improve wiring stability in environments where clean routing and firm placement matter.

The housing is made from flame-retardant polycarbonate, providing good insulation strength and durability for electrical use. The internal contact parts are made from copper alloy with tin plating, helping support dependable conductivity and long-term connection reliability. The connector is also reusable, allowing wires to be removed and reconnected when needed.

Because it combines multiple connection points, quick spring-clamp operation, and panel-mount convenience, the LT-223-8 is suitable for electricians, installers, maintenance technicians, panel builders, and workshop users looking for a reliable and space-saving wiring solution for multi-line connections.

يُعد موصل الأسلاك إل تي 223-8 من الحلول العملية جدًا لتوصيل وتوزيع عدد كبير من الأسلاك داخل اللوحات الكهربائية وصناديق التحكم والأنظمة التي تحتاج إلى ترتيب جيد للتوصيلات داخل مساحة محدودة. يأتي هذا الموديل بتصميم 8 دخل و8 خرج، مما يجعله مناسبًا لربط عدة أسلاك على التوازي داخل قطعة واحدة بشكل منظم ومرتب واحترافي.

يعتمد هذا الموصل على آلية تثبيت زنبركية تساعد على توصيل الأسلاك بسرعة وسهولة مقارنة بوسائل التوصيل التقليدية المعتمدة على المسامير. يمكن إدخال السلك وتثبيته مباشرة بدون لف أو لحام، وهو ما يسهّل التركيب ويوفر وقت العمل، كما يجعل أعمال الفك وإعادة التوصيل والصيانة أكثر راحة وسرعة. ويساعد نظام التثبيت الداخلي أيضًا على توفير ضغط ثابت على السلك للحصول على اتصال كهربائي مستقر وموثوق.

ومن أهم مميزات هذا المنتج أنه مصمم للتثبيت على اللوحة، لذلك فهو مناسب جدًا للوحات التحكم، وصناديق الكهرباء، وأنظمة الإضاءة، ووحدات التوزيع، والتوصيلات داخل الأجهزة والمعدات المختلفة. هذا النوع من التثبيت يساهم في تحسين شكل التوصيلات، وزيادة ثباتها، وتنظيم مسار الأسلاك داخل النظام بشكل أفضل، خاصة في التطبيقات التي تحتاج إلى توزيع أكثر من خط داخل مساحة عملية واحدة.

جسم الموصل مصنوع من بولي كربونات مقاوم للاشتعال، وهي خامة مناسبة للاستخدام الكهربائي وتساعد على توفير مستوى جيد من الأمان والمتانة. أما الجزء الموصل الداخلي فهو مصنوع من سبيكة نحاسية مطلية بالقصدير لدعم جودة التوصيل وثبات الأداء. كما أن الموصل قابل لإعادة الاستخدام، مما يجعله مناسبًا للتطبيقات التي تحتاج إلى تعديل أو إعادة توصيل في وقت لاحق.

إذا كنت تحتاج إلى موصل أسلاك سريع وآمن ومنظم لتوصيل ثمانية خطوط دخول وثمانية خطوط خروج داخل لوحة أو صندوق كهربائي، فإن إل تي 223-8 يقدم حلًا عمليًا ومريحًا يجمع بين سهولة الاستخدام وثبات التوصيل والحجم المناسب.

PCT-214 4 Pole Spring Lever Wire Connector Terminal Block

The PCT-214 4 Pole Spring Lever Wire Connector is a practical wiring solution for users who need a fast, reliable, and organized way to connect multiple wires. Designed with a 4-pole structure, this connector allows up to four separate conductors to be connected securely in a compact body, making it ideal for electrical installations, maintenance work, lighting circuits, control wiring, and DIY projects.

One of the main advantages of the PCT-214 connector is its spring lock lever design, which makes wire installation simple and convenient. Instead of using traditional screw terminals, each wire can be inserted and locked using an individual lever. This helps reduce installation time, makes wiring easier, and allows repeated use when adjustments or rewiring are needed.

The housing is made from modified nylon PA66 insulation material, offering good mechanical strength and electrical insulation. Inside the connector, the contact area is designed to provide dependable electrical connection with stable holding force. This makes the connector suitable for both professional and practical everyday use in electrical and low-voltage wiring tasks.

Because of its compact design, the PCT-214 is useful in applications where space is limited but a secure wire connection is still required. It is commonly used in junction work, lighting connections, distribution wiring, switch boxes, control cabinets, and other cable management tasks where neat and safe wiring matters.

For technicians, electricians, installers, maintenance users, and workshop applications, this 4 pole spring lever wire connector offers a clean and efficient alternative to conventional terminal joining methods.

يُعد موصل الأسلاك بي سي تي 214 أربع أطراف من الحلول العملية والمريحة جدًا في أعمال توصيل الأسلاك، حيث يوفر طريقة سريعة وآمنة ومنظمة لربط عدة أسلاك داخل وحدة واحدة صغيرة الحجم. يتميز هذا الموديل بتصميم أربع نقاط توصيل، مما يسمح بتوصيل أربعة موصلات داخل جسم مدمج مناسب للعديد من تطبيقات الكهرباء والتوصيلات الداخلية.

من أهم مميزات هذا الموصل أنه يعمل بنظام الرافعة الزنبركية، وهو ما يجعل الاستخدام أسهل بكثير مقارنة بأنواع التوصيل التقليدية التي تعتمد على المسامير. كل ما يحتاجه المستخدم هو رفع الرافعة، ثم إدخال السلك، ثم غلقها مرة أخرى لتثبيت السلك بشكل عملي وآمن. هذه الطريقة تساعد على تقليل وقت التركيب، وتسهل أعمال الصيانة، كما تجعل الموصل قابلًا لإعادة الاستخدام عند الحاجة إلى فك السلك أو تعديله.

جسم الموصل مصنوع من نايلون معدل من نوع بي ايه 66، وهي خامة مناسبة للعزل الكهربائي وتتحمل الاستخدام العملي بشكل جيد. كما أن الجزء الداخلي المخصص للتوصيل مصمم لتوفير تلامس ثابت يساعد على تحقيق اتصال موثوق مع تثبيت جيد للسلك أثناء التشغيل.

الحجم الصغير لهذا الموصل يجعله مناسبًا جدًا للأماكن التي تكون فيها المساحة محدودة، مثل صناديق التوصيل، ووحدات الإضاءة، ولوحات التوزيع، ولوحات التحكم، والتوصيلات الداخلية للمشاريع المختلفة. كما أنه مناسب للفنيين والكهربائيين والهواة وكل من يحتاج إلى وسيلة توصيل مرتبة وسريعة وأكثر راحة أثناء العمل.
إذا كنت تبحث عن وصلة أسلاك عملية وسهلة الاستخدام لتوصيل أربعة أسلاك داخل نقطة واحدة بشكل منظم وآمن، فإن هذا المنتج يعد خيارًا ممتازًا في كثير من تطبيقات التوصيل الكهربائي.

blocks.text: EC11 Rotary Encoder with Push Button — Threaded Shaft, 5-Pin, Detented, 15.5 mm Shaft

The EC11 Rotary Encoder with Push Button — Threaded Shaft is a detented incremental rotary encoder with an integrated momentary push switch and a 5-pin interface. It matches the previously described EC11-style unit in feel and behavior, with the key difference that this version has a threaded shaft for secure panel-nut mounting. The shaft length you measured is 15.5 mm (from the body’s top to the shaft tip).
✅ Threaded shaft for panel nut mounting: Fast, rigid installation through front panels.
🔘 Integrated push button (momentary): Distinct click on press for confirm/select actions.
🎚️ Detented rotation: Tactile clicks while rotating for step-by-step adjustments.
🔌 5-pin interface: A, B, C (common) for the encoder; SW1, SW2 for the push switch.
🎛️ Quadrature A/B output: Direction + step detection for microcontrollers and digital control.
🎚️ Front-panel UI controls: Parameter tuning, menu navigation with push-to-select.
🎼 Audio/MIDI gear: Encoder knobs on mixers, synths, controllers.
🧪 Education & prototyping: Demonstrates quadrature decoding and debouncing in MCU labs.
⚙️ Embedded systems: Rotary input with integrated push switch for compact UIs.
⚙️ Signals: Use A and B as quadrature outputs; C is common. Push switch uses SW1 and SW2 (momentary contact).
🧲 Detent vs. counts: Detents provide tactile steps; software counts A/B edges for increments.
🧼 Debouncing: Implement hardware RC or firmware debounce for A/B and the push input.
🛠️ Panel mounting: Pass the threaded shaft through the panel; secure with washer + nut. Avoid side-loading the shaft while tightening.
🔄 Direction detection: Determine rotation direction from the phase relationship of A and B.

In the world of electronics and embedded systems, accurate and reliable sensor data is essential for creating smart, responsive, and efficient devices. Designed for use with microcontrollers like Arduino, this sensor is a must-have for hobbyists, engineers, and developers working on a wide range of applications.
What is the GY-302 BH1750FVI Light Sensor Module?

The GY-302 BH1750FVI Light Intensity Illumination Module is a digital sensor module that uses the BH1750FVI ambient light sensor chip from Rohm Semiconductor. This chip is known for its high accuracy, low power consumption, and wide measurement range, making it ideal for a variety of applications that require precise light level detection. How Does the GY-302 BH1750FVI Light Sensor Work?

The sensor converts the detected light into a digital signal, which is then transmitted via the I2C interface to the connected microcontroller. The microcontroller can then process this data and use it to control other components, such as adjusting the brightness of an LED display or triggering an action based on the ambient light level.
